question: What is the build number of the latest Autodesk Fusion release?
answer:
Based on Autodesk Fusion's October 2026 release, the latest build is v.2706.1.17, dated October 28, 2026 [1]. It is a minor update to the October 2026 Major Product Update, whose highlights build is v.2706.1.14 from October 21, 2026 [1]. A search snippet from the Fusion blog lists the same v.2706.1.17 build and date [7][8].

The October 28 update brought stability fixes, including a fix for the Render workspace appearing blank when a section analysis was active [1]. Earlier 2026 releases include v.2704.1.15 from July 6, 2026 [3], so v.2706.1.17 is the newest build the sources mention.
